001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * IOB snapshot written as a bolus completes, just before {@link BolusCompletedHistoryLog};
009 * {@link IobSnapshotPreBolusHistoryLog} is its counterpart at initiation.
010 *
011 * <p>Both IOB models the pump tracks are recorded, whichever one it displays. On pumps that
012 * answered ControlIQIOBRequest within 90 s of the record, {@link #getMudaliarIob()} equalled
013 * mudaliarIOB and {@link #getSwan6hrIob()} equalled swan6hrIOB, to the milliunit. Tandem publishes
014 * no name for opcode 207, so this class name is provisional.
015 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/143.
016 */
017@HistoryLogProps(
018    opCode = 207,
019    displayName = "IOB Snapshot After Bolus"
020)
021public class IobSnapshotPostBolusHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
022
023    private int bolusId;
024    private int unknownU8At12;
025    private int selectedIob;
026    private float mudaliarIob;
027    private float swan6hrIob;
028    private float unknownFloatAt22;
029
030    public IobSnapshotPostBolusHistoryLog() {}
031
032    public IobSnapshotPostBolusHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int selectedIob, float mudaliarIob, float swan6hrIob, float unknownFloatAt22) {
033        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, unknownU8At12, selectedIob, mudaliarIob, swan6hrIob, unknownFloatAt22, 0);
034    }
035
036    public IobSnapshotPostBolusHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int selectedIob, float mudaliarIob, float swan6hrIob, float unknownFloatAt22, int headerHighNibble) {
037        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
038        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, unknownU8At12, selectedIob, mudaliarIob, swan6hrIob, unknownFloatAt22, headerHighNibble);
039        this.bolusId = bolusId;
040        this.unknownU8At12 = unknownU8At12;
041        this.selectedIob = selectedIob;
042        this.mudaliarIob = mudaliarIob;
043        this.swan6hrIob = swan6hrIob;
044        this.unknownFloatAt22 = unknownFloatAt22;
045    }
046
047    public int typeId() {
048        return 207;
049    }
050
051    /**
052     * <table border="1">
053     * <caption>Parsed fields for IobSnapshotPostBolusHistoryLog:</caption>
054     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At12</code></td><td><code>raw[12] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>selectedIob</code></td><td><code>raw[13] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
057     * <tr><td><code>mudaliarIob</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
058     * <tr><td><code>swan6hrIob</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>unknownFloatAt22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
060     * </table>
061     */
062    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
063        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
064        this.cargo = raw;
065        parseBase(raw);
066        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
067        this.unknownU8At12 = raw[12] & 0xFF;
068        this.selectedIob = raw[13] & 0xFF;
069        this.mudaliarIob = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
070        this.swan6hrIob = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
071        this.unknownFloatAt22 = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22);
072    }
073
074    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int selectedIob, float mudaliarIob, float swan6hrIob, float unknownFloatAt22, int headerHighNibble) {
075        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
076            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(207, headerHighNibble),
077            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
078            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
079            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId),
080            new byte[]{ (byte) unknownU8At12, (byte) selectedIob },
081            Bytes.toFloat(mudaliarIob),
082            Bytes.toFloat(swan6hrIob),
083            Bytes.toFloat(unknownFloatAt22)));
084    }
085
086    public int getBolusId() {
087        return bolusId;
088    }
089
090    /**
091     * @return byte 12. Meaning unknown: 1 on every Control-IQ-off pump observed, 3 on most
092     * records from pumps running Control-IQ, and occasionally 2 or 0.
093     */
094    public int getUnknownU8At12() {
095        return unknownU8At12;
096    }
097
098    /**
099     * @return the IOB model the pump displays: equal to
100     * {@link BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog#getSelectedIOB()} and to byte 12 of
101     * {@link BolusActivatedHistoryLog} for the same bolus in every record observed
102     */
103    public int getSelectedIob() {
104        return selectedIob;
105    }
106
107    public BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog.SelectedIOBType getSelectedIobType() {
108        return BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog.SelectedIOBType.fromId(selectedIob);
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * @return IOB in units under the pump's Mudaliar model, whose decay follows the profile's
113     * insulin duration. When {@link #getSelectedIob()} is 0 it equals
114     * {@link BolusCompletedHistoryLog#getIob()} bit for bit.
115     */
116    public float getMudaliarIob() {
117        return mudaliarIob;
118    }
119
120    /**
121     * @return IOB in units under the pump's Swan 6-hour model (ControlIQIOBResponse.swan6hrIOB).
122     * When {@link #getSelectedIob()} is 1 it equals
123     * {@link BolusCompletedHistoryLog#getIob()} bit for bit.
124     */
125    public float getSwan6hrIob() {
126        return swan6hrIob;
127    }
128
129    /**
130     * @return a third IOB-like value in units, of unidentified model. It is usually below
131     * {@link #getSwan6hrIob()} and decays faster. Like the Swan value, and unlike the Mudaliar
132     * one, it usually rises by exactly the delivered amount between the pre- and post-bolus
133     * snapshots of one bolus.
134     */
135    public float getUnknownFloatAt22() {
136        return unknownFloatAt22;
137    }
138}
